item.title: Netanyahu Says Plan Was to Confront Iran After October 7
item.description: In an i24NEWS interview, Benjamin Netanyahu said his intention was ultimately to confront Iran, which he called the “head of the octopus,” while also maintaining that Gaza reconstruction depends on Hamas being disarmed.

item.title: Trump Order Targeted Slavery Displays at National Parks
item.description: The Washington Post reported that National Park Service sites, including Harpers Ferry, were told to remove or revise material about slavery and racism under a 2025 executive order. A federal judge later blocked further removals in June 2026.
